idea.title: DevDigest — Daily AI-curated summary of GitHub + HN for developers

plan.tagline: Automate overdue invoice reminders for freelancers with zero setup.
plan.problem: Freelancers waste hours weekly chasing late payments, hurting cash flow and productivity.
plan.solution: CLI tool that tracks invoices, sends automated polite reminders, and generates reports—all offline-first with SQLite.
plan.target_market: Solo developers, indie hackers, and small business owners who bill hourly or per-project and need lightweight automation.
mvp_features: Auto-send email reminders via local SMTP
plan.demo_script: Run `invoice-chaser --demo` to see 3 mock invoices (1 overdue), generate a report, and simulate email reminders—all without internet.
plan.phuket_angle: Perfect for Phuket-based freelancers (e.g., diving instructors, tour guides) who bill tourists post-service and need lightweight, offline-friendly payment tracking.
